text:
```yaml
name: Close inactive issues

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"

jobs:
  close-issues:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          days-before-issue-stale: 700
          days-before-issue-close: 30
          stale-issue-message: "This issue has been marked as stale due to 700 days of inactivity. It will be closed in 30 days if no further activity occurs."
          close-issue-message: "This issue was closed because it has been inactive for over 2 years."
          exempt-issue-labels: "data-issue"
          days-before-pr-stale: -1
          days-before-pr-close: -1
          operations-per-run: 100
```
